channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: Nemotron-Personas-Finance-Japan: A Synthetic Dataset Capturing Japan's Demographics and Financial Context
item.description: NVIDIA and Elith released Nemotron-Personas-Finance-Japan, described as the first million-record open persona dataset combining Japanese official statistics with household finance and financial literacy data, with Sompo Japan feedback and CC BY 4.0 commercial licensing. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
item.description: ChatGPT Enterprise is now available in AWS Marketplace, letting organizations buy and manage it through their existing AWS purchasing and billing relationship and count eligible spend toward AWS commitments. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Claude Fable 5.2 in GitHub Copilot
item.description: Claude Fable 5.2 is now generally available in GitHub Copilot for complex, multistep coding across large codebases, and in early testing it solved more tasks than Fable 5.1 with fewer steps and tool calls, though admins must manually enable the data-retention policy. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Your Experts Have Partners. There's HOPE for Keeping Them Together
item.description: Second-order HOPE expert pruning targets Qwen3.5-122B's 48 MoE layers of 256 experts, where expert MLPs occupy 95% of ~250 GB memory though each token uses only 8, beating the next-best by up to 6.1% at 50% pruning on agentic coding. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: Control Room: A central system to track and stop model workloads across our research infrastructure
item.description: Control Room centrally tracks model workloads across OpenAI's research infrastructure, including agentic sampling, and can stop model output within 35 seconds of a decision to intervene. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Secret scanning detects secrets in GitHub Actions workflow logs
item.description: GitHub secret scanning now detects secrets in GitHub Actions workflow logs, scanning completed runs for provider patterns, with the feature in public preview and alerts retained even after logs are deleted. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: CodeRabbit scales agentic software development and ships 20x more
item.description: CodeRabbit used Codex to help the same engineering team ship roughly 20x more software in six months, while its OpenAI reasoning model-based reviews of AI-generated code serve over 20,000 organizations and 150,000 open-source projects. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Is the free ride over? Samsung Galaxy AI prepares to charge $4.99 a month
item.description: Samsung is preparing a Galaxy AI Premium subscription at $4.99 per month or $47.99 per year, while free-tier features face usage caps and on-device AI video generation moves behind the paywall. (AIbase)

item.title: Kuken Industries searches 70 years of drawings in minutes
item.description: Kuken Industries’ OpenAI case study promises searching 70 years of drawings in minutes, but the page body displays only Internal Server Error, so readers must verify the claimed method themselves. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Qwen Office 2.0 launches, positioned as a Team Agent with upgrades across three tracks: collaboration, automated tasks, and human-AI co-creation
item.description: Qwen Office 2.0, released November 9 and positioned as a Team Agent, upgrades collaboration, automated tasks and human-AI co-creation with Collaboration Spaces and a digital employee, Xiao Q, that links DingTalk group chats, meeting notes and documents as context. (AIbase)

item.title: ByteDance releases Seedream 5.5 with support for 100-turn continuous editing and native transparent output, raising the ceiling for AI image creation
item.description: ByteDance Seed's Seedream 5.5, announced November 9, supports up to 100 rounds of continuous editing, pixel-level preservation of unedited regions and native RGBA transparent output, while improving texture and text rendering for professional visual production. (AIbase)

item.title: When 200,000 employees meet 20 million agents: Nadella outlines Microsoft's new staffing model
item.description: Satya Nadella envisions Microsoft’s 200,000 employees working alongside 20 million AI agents, and says he personally runs 100 command-line sessions to operate 100 agents at once, increasing the management burden. (AIbase)

item.title: Anthropic launches new Claude Fable and Mythos 5.2 models
item.description: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2, available today, and Claude Mythos 5.2, restricted to vetted organizations, claiming the pre-release model designed three electronic devices from scratch. (The Verge)

item.title: Volcano Engine launches Seedream5.5: pixel-level controllable editing that holds up through 100 rounds of edits
item.description: Volcengine’s Seedream5.5, released November 9, adds pixel-level controllable editing and sustains subject and lighting consistency across hundreds of consecutive edits while costing 0.28 yuan per 2K square-image edit, 60% less than Seedream5.0 Pro. (AIbase)

item.title: Dageno AI 2.0 — See why AI recommends your competitors instead of you
item.description: Dageno AI 2.0 claims to explain why AI recommends your competitors instead of you, but the page currently shows only a CAPTCHA security verification that readers must pass to access the actual content. (Product Hunt)

item.title: Meta rolls out a major upgrade: specialized models trained on Muse Wonder are now live across Muse and Meta AI
item.description: On November 6, Meta rolled out a dedicated Muse Wonder-based model to Muse and Meta AI, lifting a score from 38% to 47% and adding Active Memory. (AIbase)

item.title: homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp — Configure and automate Home Assistant with Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants.
item.description: The ha-mcp integration runs inside the Home Assistant process after installation via HACS, letting Claude and ChatGPT configure and automate Home Assistant, with the caution that each client should use only one installation method. (GitHub Trending)

item.title: Product Hunt MCP — The community you trust in the assistant you use
item.description: The Product Hunt MCP page returns only a 403 Forbidden error demanding JavaScript and cookies, leaving no readable content behind its promise of trusted community inside your assistant. (Product Hunt)

item.title: Claude Fable 5.2 scores 65 in human analysis, the highest score to date
item.description: Claude Fable 5.2 scores 65 on Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index versus a median of 40, but a comparison of quality, price and performance shows 275M generated tokens, 44.1 minutes per task and $26.54 cost. (artificialanalysis.ai)

item.title: Google Gemini forwards personal Drive files and emails to human annotators
item.description: Google Help page 16836988 confirms Gemini routes Drive and Gmail content to human reviewers, and testing found prompts without @ mentions still trigger retrieval, with four results injecting complete unredacted files. (github.com)
